description: Immediate threat to safety or output. Requires the line to be stopped, immediate escalation, and manager acknowledgement within 15 minutes.
Significant degradation requiring intervention within the hour. Escalated immediately and acknowledged by a manager, without stopping the line.
Developing condition to be addressed within the working day. Manager acknowledgement is required but immediate escalation is not.
Minor deviation recorded for routine attention. No escalation and no acknowledgement required.
Informational notice retained for the record only. Carries no response target and no acknowledgement requirement.
